overall: No blocking implementation issue found. Approved parameter thresholds, tier session counts, chart classification and disclosed estimate caveats are internally consistent.

findings.finding: The state note cites a 4-Spark cluster as an example in the small-server band. At the tier file's stated 121.7 GiB per Spark, four provide 486.8 GiB aggregate, below DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's 540 GiB one-session estimate and 584.7 GiB four-session budget. That example does not meet the all-resident V4.1 estimate; the row's generic 768 GiB planning capacity does fit, but no concrete configuration or price supporting that capacity is verified.
findings.impact: Keep the SGD band visibly indicative, and avoid treating four Sparks as a qualifying V4.1 configuration. The slide already says deployments, model-specific sharding, and throughput are unverified; the state note is the inconsistent detail.

findings.finding: The memory calculation takes the larger of the 4-bit shared-weight fallback and researched single-session resident footprint plus 16 GB per additional session; it raises tiers when the planning capacity is exceeded. Tier concurrency is 1/1/1 then 4/8/16, and the slide discloses shared weights, nominal session headroom, indicative budgets, and no latency/throughput or qualifying-deployment guarantee.
findings.impact: Consistent with the approved fallback and parallelism policy.

findings.location: 01-intro/data/model_hardware.csv GLM-5.3 Flash and Kimi K3 rows; 01-intro/slides.typ hardware slide
findings.finding: GLM-5.3 Flash is placed in the two-Spark/large-desktop tier at estimated 224 GiB, below its 243.4 GiB planning capacity; its first-hand 4-bit deployment source reports a 176 GiB checkpoint on two Sparks, while exact minimum residency remains labeled unverified. Kimi K3 uses sourced 2.8T total parameters, exceeds the 1.6T threshold, and lands in the open-ended high-end tier; the slide labels this as an estimate and states actual high-end node count/cost depends on workload.
findings.impact: The two highlighted model placements and their caveats match the requested constraints.
